questions.note_md:
**Done 2026-09-11: decoder noise must be detached from the encoder.**
- **In graph** (`BSC:45529827`, ep 37): Eval +28.1%, `ZPartRank` halved; z grows 1.91× to outrun a fixed σ. The mode is removed from the code. [deck](results/2026-09-08_tc_width_decnoise_e2e_tc512_read_slides.html)

[ep 60](results/2026-09-10_tc_width_decnoise_detach_tc512_slides.html), [ep 100](results/2026-09-11_tc_width_decnoise_detach_tc512_ep100_slides.html)
- **Flow on it** (`BSC:45736861`) ties tc128 at N = 20 (raymap 6.46 vs 6.45). Its Waymo ladder is as flat as ft10's, so decoder tolerance is not the gap. questions.item: Detached decoder-noise at full width (tc1536, no channel bottleneck), and the unnormalised z it exposed
questions.note: Done 2026-09-16: width buys ~2× recon, but nothing normalises z at tc1536. No bottleneck (BSC:45610897): LossRecon −51.6% / −49.2% vs tc512 at ep 31, but ZPartRank 1.0 and ZRowMeanSquare 872 throughout. It is a sparse heavy tail on one channel (~0.57% of rows at ~1.5e4) that SIGReg's bounded statistic cannot see. deck Forced LN + square Linear bottleneck (BSC:45678654): fixes the scale (RMS 1.13) but costs ×3.2 recon with a flat σ ladder. The whitened arms BSC:45831174 / 45831175 stalled at the copy plateau: encoder/decoder grad 0.006 vs 0.131. analysis SIGReg pool 24576 (BSC:45727710): frees the code (rank 245 / 352 by ep 31, RMS 1.11) at +16–19% LossRecon vs pool 8192 (BSC:45725881). deck Split into question/15–17; the seed replicate became question/19. deck

questions.note: Closed 2026-09-16: yes, on one seed per arm. With the square LN bottleneck, SIGReg warmup 0 (BSC:45831175) sat at KITTI LossRecon 0.1293 with a flat σ ladder. questions.item: Can a frozen auxiliary raymap head on the DeltaTok decoder supervise flow training and close the raymap gap?
questions.note: Opened 2026-09-17, not started. Proposal: an auxiliary raymap head on the DeltaTok decoder, frozen, as extra flow supervision. questions.item: Why does the flow's forecast camera stall after the context frames, and does conditioning on the GT pose fix it?
questions.note: Diagnosed: the flow's tokens drop the motion; the decoder and the pose fit are fine. probe_flow_motion.py (BSC:47023529, 47025543; 64 windows per split): GT deltas decode a path of 0.98–1.12× GT; the 1-step flow 0.00–0.29×, and it stalls on train windows too. GT + random noise at the flow's token MSE keeps the camera (ATE 2.1–6.9 m vs flow 12.7–19.6 m): the error's direction matters, not its size. z = 0, the context delta repeated and 0.5× GT all decode as "copy frame t". KITTI never trained at 518×168. Oracle GT pose (BSC:47029284, ep 5): not worth pursuing. LossFlow −5 to −14%, geometry within ±5%. deck Probe at iter 12k: pose on vs off gives the same z (progress, size, ATE agree to 3 decimals on all 5 sets), so the flow ignores the pose. Progress probe v3 (BSC:47072408, control iter 50k; 64 windows per set). Progress = the predicted layer-12 change since the last observed frame, projected on the true change (0 = copy, 1 = truth). DA3's camera has a cliff: 25% of the way stalls, 75% matches the true features (ATE 1.1–3.5 m), 50% is erratic. The flow's off-axis error is harmless: true features + the 1-step flow's off-axis error give ATE 1.1–4.5 m. Its progress alone stalls. 1-step progress 0.39–0.41 on train / nuScenes / Waymo, 0.23 on KITTI; its tokens are 0.48–0.59× the true size. Scaling the flow's change ×2 / ×4 does not fix the camera (11.5–17.8 m). Multires (BSC:47076092: 47022776 at 27k, 47058660 at 30k). KITTI 1-step progress 0.40–0.41 vs 0.23 for the control at 50k; elsewhere on the control's iteration curve. The gain per e-fold of iterations falls from ~0.13 (12k → 30k) to ~0.04 (30k → 50k, cross-run): likely a plateau near 0.4–0.5, short of the 0.75 the camera needs. Multi-res BSC:47022776 COMPLETED 2026-10-09 11:10 at ep 24 / 50k, not continued: the z-cache twin BSC:47058660 runs the recipe 4.3× faster and is still training (deck, plan).
questions.note_md:
**Diagnosed: the flow's tokens drop the motion; the decoder and the pose fit are fine.** `probe_flow_motion.py` (`BSC:47023529`, `47025543`; 64 windows per split):
- GT deltas decode a path of 0.98–1.12× GT; the 1-step flow 0.00–0.29×, and it stalls on train windows too.
- GT + random noise at the flow's token MSE keeps the camera (ATE 2.1–6.9 m vs flow 12.7–19.6 m): the error's direction matters, not its size.
- z = 0, the context delta repeated and 0.5× GT all decode as "copy frame t".
- KITTI never trained at 518×168.

**Oracle GT pose (`BSC:47029284`, ep 5): not worth pursuing.** `LossFlow` −5 to −14%, geometry within ±5%. [deck](results/2026-10-08_flow_posecond_oracle_pose_slides.html) Probe at iter 12k: pose on vs off gives the same z (progress, size, ATE agree to 3 decimals on all 5 sets), so the flow ignores the pose.

**Progress probe v3 (`BSC:47072408`, control iter 50k; 64 windows per set).** Progress = the predicted layer-12 change since the last observed frame, projected on the true change (0 = copy, 1 = truth).
- DA3's camera has a cliff: 25% of the way stalls, 75% matches the true features (ATE 1.1–3.5 m), 50% is erratic.
- The flow's off-axis error is harmless: true features + the 1-step flow's off-axis error give ATE 1.1–4.5 m. Its progress alone stalls.
- 1-step progress 0.39–0.41 on train / nuScenes / Waymo, 0.23 on KITTI; its tokens are 0.48–0.59× the true size. Scaling the flow's change ×2 / ×4 does not fix the camera (11.5–17.8 m).

**Multires (`BSC:47076092`: `47022776` at 27k, `47058660` at 30k).** KITTI 1-step progress 0.40–0.41 vs 0.23 for the control at 50k; elsewhere on the control's iteration curve. The gain per e-fold of iterations falls from ~0.13 (12k → 30k) to ~0.04 (30k → 50k, cross-run): likely a plateau near 0.4–0.5, short of the 0.75 the camera needs.

Multi-res `BSC:47022776` COMPLETED 2026-10-09 11:10 at ep 24 / 50k, not continued: the z-cache twin `BSC:47058660` runs the recipe 4.3× faster and is still training ([deck](results/2026-10-08_flow_multires_training_progress_slides.html), [plan](plan/2026-10-07_flow_frozen_encode_zcache.md)).
